ai_summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL) disclosed a demand order totaling Rs. 33.42 lakhs, including tax, interest, and penalty, from the Assistant Commissioner, Chennai-South, related to alleged discrepancies in credit notes and E-waybills. The company plans to appeal the order, asserting it is not tenable and anticipates no material financial or operational impact, though the substantial interest component, almost matching the tax amount, could indicate prolonged regulatory scrutiny or historical compliance issues.
